scope: This matrix describes source features produced by the CSmith generator options. The fixed CSmith checksum runtime and clightgen output also contribute already-admitted support globals such as string literals and crc32_tab.

feature_families.correspondence: whole-program initialization, global lvalue lookup, assignment, and CSmith runs have soundness theorems
feature_families.limits: Beyond scalar globals, arrays, pointers, int8, uint8, bounded structs and unions, long long, and floating point are separately enabled below; volatile accesses remain disabled. Runtime support globals are outside this generator-option classification.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for global array initialization, array-to-pointer decay, indexed loads, and indexed stores
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, program initialization, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The profile pins --max-array-dim 3 and --max-array-len-per-dim 4. The isolated GeneratedCases Lean library uses maxRecDepth 4096 because array-heavy exports can exceed Lean's default elaboration recursion depth; maxHeartbeats remains unchanged. Pointer generation is separately bounded below. The profile passes CSmith --no-hash-value-printf so array checksum traversal does not emit unsupported diagnostic printf calls.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for pointer-valued global initialization, address-of, dereference, pointer arguments, and scalar loads/stores through pointers
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, function-entry, control-step, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The profile pins --max-pointer-depth 3 and disables volatile and const pointer qualifiers. The focused fixtures cover global Init_addrof chains through three levels, triple dereference read-modify-write, same-array ordering, pointer equality/inequality, and null comparison. Structs and unions remain disabled; comparisons across unrelated non-null object blocks are not an admitted use.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for composite layout, initialized struct globals, field lvalues, field loads/stores, and aggregate By_copy assignment
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, program initialization, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The profile pins --max-struct-fields 6, --no-packed-struct, --no-arg-structs, and --no-return-structs because the pinned CompCert target does not admit struct parameters or returns without its unsupported -fstruct-passing option. Bitfields remain disabled; unions are separately enabled below. Arrays and bounded pointers remain enabled to exercise ordinary struct interactions.

feature_families.relational_semantics: supported for member layout and aggregate copy
feature_families.functional_executor: supported for active-member field reads/writes and aggregate By_copy assignment
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, program initialization, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The profile pins --max-union-fields 3, --no-arg-unions, --no-return-unions, and --take-no-union-field-addr. The current CSmith version can still emit union-valued function boundaries despite its no-arg/no-return flags; the transformer retains and classifies those target-ABI-incompatible sources before CompCert compilation. Bitfields remain disabled. Focused fixtures use only the initialized or last-written active member; inactive-member reads are not an admitted deterministic subset.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for Mint8unsigned initialization, load, narrowing store, and zero-extension
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, program initialization, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The initial fixture validates unsigned 8-bit wraparound through explicit narrowing and zero-extension to the checksum helper. Signed int8 is separately enabled below.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for Mint8signed initialization, load, narrowing store, and sign extension
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, program initialization, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The fixture uses a representable signed result (-5) and validates sign extension. The CSmith safe-math profile remains responsible for avoiding undefined signed-overflow expressions in generated programs.

feature_families.correspondence: expression and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The fixture uses a nonzero unsigned divisor. Generated programs retain CSmith safe-math wrappers, which guard division and arithmetic corner cases.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for Vlong/Mint64 initialization, 64-bit arithmetic, signed and unsigned division, and narrowing casts
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, program initialization, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: CSmith requires both --longlong and --math64 for its allow_int64 gate; both are enabled by removing their disabling flags. The fixed checksum external remains uint32, so fixtures explicitly cast Vlong results to unsigned int rather than requiring source-level %llx varargs.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported through deterministic Sgoto/Slabel control transitions and find_label
feature_families.correspondence: control-step and whole-run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The fixture exercises a forward goto. Source-level assignment/sequence operators are separately enabled below after validating their frontend normalization.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported through the ordinary lowered Sassign, Sset, Ebinop, Ecast, Evar, and control transitions
feature_families.correspondence: the executor correspondence surface applies to the Clight AST exported after frontend normalization
feature_families.limits: The profile admits compound assignments, embedded assignments, comma operators, unary plus, and pre/post increment/decrement. The source fixture confirms clightgen lowers these to already-supported Clight forms rather than requiring new executor expression constructors.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for initialized readonly globals and scalar loads
feature_families.correspondence: whole-program initialization, expression, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover the executed primitives
feature_families.limits: The fixture reads a const-qualified global and does not attempt to write it. The profile still excludes volatiles, builtins, and argc; structs, unions, long long, floating point, and pointers are separately bounded above.

feature_families.functional_executor: supported for binary32/binary64 initialization, arithmetic, ordered comparisons, casts, and the CSmith safe-wrapper fabs/fabsf calls
feature_families.correspondence: expression, assignment, program initialization, and CSmith run soundness theorems cover executed internal primitives; owned CSmith fabs/fabsf calls have executor-only and specialized relation transition characterizations
feature_families.limits: The profile uses --float --strict-float. CSmith safe floating wrappers call only exact non-vararg fabs/fabsf ABIs, which the restricted executor owns; native builds link libm. General math-library externals, C source varargs, NaN payload/exception observability, and volatile floating accesses are outside this profile.

feature_families.functional_executor: not admitted by the corpus profile
